_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Laminating Process Description (Boats)
summary: Specifies the format and content for describing the laminating process used to fabricate fiber reinforced plastic boat hulls in accordance with contract drawings and specifications.
description_purpose: The Laminating Process Description delineates the procedure used in fabricating fiber reinforced plastic boats in accordance with the drawings and specifications applicable to the contract. This is to insure that the contractor's process meets the specification requirements.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This data item description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
7.2 This DID applicable to the construction of fiber reinforced plastic hulls.
7.3 This supersedes UDI-E-23086.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: General
preparation_instructions.content: For each of the items below, describe the quality control and inspection procedures by which compliance with the requirements of the specification will be assured, or refer to the appropriate section of the contractor's quality assurance or inspection document. Include job titles, inspection intervals, and record keeping procedures. Where information concerning methods is required, include tools, equipment, procedures, and quality controls used.

children.title: For each of the materials used in lamination and assembly, identify:
Manufacturer
Specification (by part or model number, or by Federal, Military, or commercial specification)
Method of storage (protection from heat and weather, temperature and humidity control)
Laminating Process
Temperature and humidity control and monitoring in the laminating facility
children.content: Describe the methods of temperature and humidity control and monitoring in the laminating facility.

children.title: Preparation of the molds for lamination
children.content: Identify the methods of preparation of the molds for lamination. Include repair polishing methods, type, and method of application of mold release agents.

children.title: Chronology of the hull laminating process
children.content: Provide a chronology of the hull laminating process from the application of the gel coat to the beginning of the application of the hull internal structure. Include the time elapsed from the application of the gel coat, and the time and number of persons required to complete each operation. Include time and duration of breaks in the process, and identify use of scaffolding and rolling of the mold.

children.title: Method of application of the gel coat
children.content: Identify the method of application of the gel coat, the gel time used, and the method by which thickness is monitored and controlled.

children.title: Promoter, accelerator, catalyst, thixotrope and other gel coat and laminating resin additives
children.content: Identify when and by what methods the promoter, accelerator, catalyst, thixotrope and other gel coat and laminating resin additives, as applicable, will be measured and mixed into the resin.

children.title: Gel times used with the laminating resin
children.content: Identify the gel times used with the laminating resin at each stage of the laminating process, and the means by which the gel time will be monitored and controlled.

children.title: Method of application of the reinforcing material and laminating resin
children.content: Describe the method of application of the reinforcing material and laminating resin. Include direction of lay-up, location of laps, precutting and templating of operations used, methods used to wet out and consolidate the laminate and to remove air, and methods used to monitor and control resin content. Provide sketches detailing treatment of laps and doubler at chines, keel, transom corners, stem, and doublers.

children.title: Cored laminate
children.content: If a cored laminate is used, describe the type of core and whether solid, scored, perforated or otherwise machined to improve conformity to the laminate. Describe the method used to precoat the core. Describe the method of preparing and bedding the core in the laminate and of assuring complete contact of the core with the laminate. If a syntactic foam bedding material is used, describe the methods used to mix, catalyse and apply the bedding foam, and the means by which the gel time will be monitored and controlled. Describe the methods by which complete contact of the core with the bedding foam will be monitored and maintained.

children.title: Secondarily bonded structures and doublers
children.content: Describe methods used to install secondarily bonded structures and doublers. Describe surface preparation and cleaning methods.

children.title: Surface sealing resin
children.content: Identify the surface sealing resin used. Describe method of application, means of achieving surface cure, and means of controlling thickness.

children.title: Assembly
Part at time of removal from the mold
children.content: Describe the part at time of removal from the mold. Identify the structural components such as bulkheads and framing which are installed, Barcol readings taken, and whether surface sealing resin has been applied.

children.title: Methods used to remove the part from the mold
children.content: Describe the methods used to remove the part from the mold.

children.title: Laminate inspection and repair procedures
children.content: Describe laminate inspection and repair procedures.

children.title: Edge trimming and sealing procedures
children.content: Describe edge trimming and sealing procedures.

children.title: Preparation for final assembly and final assembly of major structural connections
children.content: Describe the method of preparation for final assembly and final assembly of major structural connections. Include the hull-deck connection and other major structural connections, if used.

children.title: Storage and protection of parts prior to final assembly, finish painting and delivery
children.content: Describe the method of storage and protection of parts prior to final assembly, finish painting and delivery.
